prompt:
8. Import/Export: Allow users to export diagrams as high-quality PNGs, SVGs, and PDFs. Implement robust local storage with multi-document management, allowing users to switch between different projects.
9. Collaboration Ready Foundation: Structure the state management using CRDTs (Conflict-free Replicated Data Types) or an event-sourcing pattern so that real-time multiplayer co-editing could be easily dropped in later.

Provide a complete, production-ready implementation, ensuring the highest level of execution polish and a genuinely premium user experience. Write focused unit tests for the core canvas state logic and the undo/redo stack.
